subject: Possibly incorrect results of cross-lagged sem combining categorical and continuous variables

messages.author: cb0c55b0ab30311d
messages.subject: Possibly incorrect results of cross-lagged sem combining categorical and continuous variables
parts:
Dear all,

I've just started using R and lavaan about two weeks ago and I'm rather enjoying it =)

However, I now get some weird results and I wonder if I misspecified the model.

The model is cross-lagged, three latent variables with categorical indicators and three continuous variables.

I've done CFAs for the measurement model first and they are fine.

It is a multiple group model, with 200 and 250 cases, respectively.

My code is this:

Model <- 't1 =~ S1_L1 + S1_L2 + S1_L3
               t2 =~ S2_L1 + S2_L2 + S2_L3
               t3 =~ S3_L1 + S3_L2 + S3_L3

    #correlated uniqueness
           S1_L1~~S3_L1
           S1_L1~~S2_L1
           S2_L1~~S3_L1

           S1_L2~~S3_L2
           S1_L2~~S2_L2
           S2_L2~~S3_L2

           S1_L3~~S3_L3
           S1_L3~~S2_L3
           S2_L3~~S3_L3

    #hier werden die A-Variablen latent definiert
        fSL1 =~ 1*A1_L
        A1_L ~~ 0*A1_L

        fSL2 =~ 1*A2_L
        A2_L ~~ 0*A2_L

        fSL3 =~ 1*A3_L
        A3_L ~~ 0*A3_L

    #hier kommen die weiteren Korrelationen hinzu
           t1 ~~ fSL1
           t2 ~~ fSL2
           t3 ~~ fSL3

    #hier kommen die Kreuzpfade hinzu
           t2 ~ t1 + fSL1
           t3 ~ t1 + t2 + fSL1 + fSL2
           fSL2 ~ fSL1 + t1
           fSL3 ~ fSL1 + fSL2 + t1 + t2'

fit <- sem(Model, data = mydata, group = "FOSET", missing="pairwise",
            ordered=c("S1_L1","S1_L2", "S1_L3",
            "S2_L1", "S2_L2", "S2_L3",
            "S3_L1","S3_L2", "S3_L3"))

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Possibly incorrect results of cross-lagged sem combining categorical and continuous variables
parts:
On 05/15/2015 01:46 PM, Thorsten Gorges wrote:
> lavaan (0.5-19.848) converged normally after 6910 iterations

That is a lot of iterations.

I think lavaan has trouble with this model, and you will have to provide
(much) better starting values, in particular for the regression part
(and the residual variances).

Try adding one regression at a time. If the results look good, use the
estimates as starting values for a next model, with another regression.

Yves.
